DMG packaging is macOS-only.

Current host: Linux
Requested output: /workspace/ChatGPT_Pro/dist/EggEvolutionMatch.dmg

If your goal is Apple App Store (iOS) deployment, build an IPA instead:
  npm run deploy:ios

If you really need DMG, run this on macOS with Xcode tools:
  APP_PATH=/path/to/EggEvolutionMatch.app npm run package:dmg
